product_metadata.title: Dyson Flagship V7 Allergy HEPA Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner: Lightweight, Powerful Suction, Handheld Ergonomic, Bagless, Height Adjustable, Rechargeable Battery, w/OneHubxcelMicrofiber Cloth
features: 【Powered by the Dyson digital motor V7 】 Engineered for powerful suction on carpets and hard floors; No-touch dirt emptying : No need to touch the dirt – just pull the lever to release.
【Whole-machine HEPA filtration】 Whole machine HEPA filtration captures dusts and expels cleaner air than the air you breathe.

【Hygienic bin emptying+ Docking station 】 Just push the button to release the dirt. Tidily stores and recharges your Dyson V7 vacuum, so always ready for use.; Easily reaches up high : Lightweight and ergonomic to clean high-up places with one smooth motion

【Cord free+ Lightweight and versatile】 Hassle free. Filtration : Washable lifetime filter. Whole machine HEPA filtration captures allergens and expels cleaner air than the air you breathe. Lightweight and versatile, for easy home cleaning. Instant-release trigger means battery power is only used while it’s cleaning. Requires charging for 3.5 hours minimum before first use

【Combination tool + Authorized W/HubxcelMicrofiber Cloth】 Two tools in one, for simple switching between surfaces; Crevice tool : Designed for precise cleaning around edges and narrow gaps; Up to 30 minutes of fade-free power : Powerful suction for whole-home cleaning. Actual run time will vary based on power mode and/or attachments used. 【Authorized W/HubxcelMicrofiber Cloth】one cloth per order, colors may vary.
description: Dyson V7 Allergy Cordless HEPA Vacuum

cord-free vacuum has 75% more brush bar power than the Dyson V6 Cord-Free vacuum. Engineered for all floor types, the Direct-drive cleaner head drives bristles into the carpet to remove ground-in dirt. The Dyson V7

cord-free vacuum quickly transforms to a handheld for quick clean ups, spot cleaning and cleaning difficult places. Cord-free. Hassle-free. Powerful suction. Up to 30 minutes of powerful fade-free suction. Trigger releases instantly.

The Direct-drive cleaner head drives bristles deep into the carpet to remove ground-in dirt. It has 75% more brush bar power than the Dyson V6 Cord-free vacuum. Transforms to a handheld for beyond the floor cleaning. Hygienic dirt ejector empties dust from the bin in a single action. 2 Tier radial cyclones – 15 cyclones, arranged across two tiers, work in parallel to increase airflow and capture fine dust.
All Dyson cordless vacuums quickly convert to a handheld for quick clean ups, spot cleaning , cleaning difficult places.
